svg.title: Four-hole ocarina in D4, elongated-square-pyramid, sheet 1 of 1
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. Four-hole ocarina in D4, English fingering, elongated-square-pyramid, sheet 1 of 1: bird, chin layer, face, mouth face, top plate. 3mm ply, drawn for a 0.13mm kerf. The duct is a fill engrave in two inks, run either or both: red #ff0000 in the bird's underside, magenta #ff00ff in the top's outside face. One alone about 1mm deep, both about 0.5mm each -- set the depth on scrap first. Blue #0000ff engraves single lines: on the top, which lies outside face up, a line across past the window where the 30 degree bevel filed on its far edge should reach; on every other plate, inside face up, the corner numbers, each carried by the plates that meet at that corner. Then the cuts: orange #ff8000 cuts the window and the holes, and black #000000 frees the parts.
